# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We want this project to be a welcoming and respectful place for everyone who
participates. Contributors, maintainers, and users are expected to help create
an environment free from harassment and discrimination.

## Expected behavior

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment include:

- Being respectful and considerate in discussions and reviews.
- Giving and accepting constructive feedback.
- Focusing on the issue, code, or proposal rather than the person.
- Respecting different experiences, backgrounds, and points of view.
- Reporting problems through the appropriate private channel.

## Unacceptable behavior

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, personal attacks,
deliberate intimidation, unwanted sexual attention, publishing private
information, and any other conduct that would reasonably be considered
inappropriate in a professional community.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior to the repository maintainers privately through
the contact information listed in the repository profile or by opening a
private security report when the issue is sensitive. Please include enough
information for the maintainers to understand and investigate the incident.

Maintainers may remove comments, reject contributions, or restrict
participation when necessary to protect the community. Reports will be handled
as confidentially as possible.

This Code of Conduct applies wherever someone is representing or participating
in this project.
